# Errors

Every I/O method is blocking and returns its value directly. Failures are
thrown as an unchecked `dev.unofficialbox.runtime.Runtime.BoxApiException` — either a
transport failure or a non-2xx response after the network layer's retries
(exponential backoff + jitter, `401` refresh, `Retry-After`). Because it extends
`RuntimeException`, you catch it only where you mean to handle it:

```java
try {
    var file = client.files.get(fileId, null);
} catch (dev.unofficialbox.runtime.Runtime.BoxApiException e) {
    // a non-2xx response: e.statusCode(), e.code(), e.boxMessage(),
    // e.requestId(), e.body(); statusCode() is 0 for any other failure
}
```

## Etags: `If-None-Match` and `If-Match`

Files and folders carry an `etag`. Send it back to stay in sync with Box
(Box's [Ensure consistency](https://developer.box.com/guides/api-calls/ensure-consistency/)
guide):

- **Reads** — a file, folder, or web link `get`, and each shared-item lookup, has an
  `…IfModified` variant that takes the stored etag, sends it as
  `If-None-Match`, and returns `Optional.empty()` when Box answers `304 Not Modified`:
  keep your cached copy. (The plain method surfaces that 304 as the error
  above if you set `if-none-match` on it yourself.)
- **Writes** — pass the etag as `ifMatch` on a file, folder, or web link update or
  delete, or a new file version upload. Box answers `412 Precondition
  Failed` (code `precondition_failed`) when the item changed since you read
  it, and `e.isPreconditionFailed()` reports it: read it again, reapply your
  change, retry. `If-Match` can't block a move.

```java
var file = client.files.getIfModified(fileId, etag, null);
if (file.isEmpty()) {
    // unchanged since etag
}

// Re-read and retry: the update lands only on the version it was made from.
var guarded = new FilesManager.UpdateOptions();
guarded.ifMatch = etag;
for (int attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
    try {
        client.files.update(fileId, body, guarded);
        break;
    } catch (dev.unofficialbox.runtime.Runtime.BoxApiException e) {
        if (!e.isPreconditionFailed() || attempt == 3) throw e;
        var current = client.files.get(fileId, null);
        guarded.ifMatch = current.etag().value(); // reapply your change to current here
    }
}
```
